Arrival in Canaima and the lagoon waterfalls

provenance.rationale: Contextual label derived from the cited Word paragraph for this specific itinerary field.

blocks.text: Transfer to domestic airport for 7 am flight to Canaima National Park. Canaima is located at a peaceful lagoon on the Carrao River and surrounded by exotic cascades such as the Hacha and Ucaima falls. Upon arrival you will be greeted with a welcome drink and your room keys will be handed out. After settling in your room you will enjoy a delicious lunch buffet while looking over the Canaima Lagoon. Rest and prepare for adventure! Board the dugout canoe and cross the lagoon to visit Hacha and Sapo falls, where you will able to walk through the back of the water curtain, get energized and make great pictures. Return to lodge for a fabulous romantic dinner and sleep. (B,L,D)
